title: Digital Marketing Associate
description:

* **3\+ years** 

 of hands\-on experience in
 
**Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing / User Acquisition.**

**B2C / consumer\-facing**

**Meta Ads and Google Ads.**

title: Growth Marketing Associate (ABM & Email Marketing)
description:
**About Trademo**




  





 At Trademo, we are transforming global trade and supply chains by leveraging cutting\-edge AI technology to provide businesses with unparalleled visibility, compliance, and intelligence solutions. Our AI\-driven platform simplifies the complexities of international trade, helping companies mitigate risks, enhance efficiency, and make data\-driven decisions with confidence.
 



  





**Our AI\-Enhanced Solutions:**



* ✅ Trademo Intel – AI\-powered trade intelligence to uncover market trends and competitive insights.
* ✅ Trademo Sanctions Screener – AI\-driven compliance with 650\+ global sanctions and PEP lists.
* ✅ Trademo Global Trade Compliance – Real\-time regulatory and tariff data for 140\+ countries, with AI workflows for HS/ECN classification, controls determination, and licensing.
* ✅ Trademo Map \- AI\-powered global supply chain mapping and screening, detecting risks like Forced Labor (UFLPA) and sanctions in deep\-tier networks.
* ✅ Trademo TradeScreen \- AI\-powered trade transaction digitization, financial crime screening and compliance platform.



  





 Trademo collects and integrates diverse open\-source data points to create our AI\-driven knowledge graph, TrademoKG. These data points include Customs Declarations, Shipping Data, Satellite Data, AIS Data, Vessels, Web Footprints, Global Tariffs \& Duties, FTAs, Import/Export Controls, Export Licenses, Key Personnel \& Ownership, Company Financials, and Company Legal information. By analyzing trade data from 200\+ countries, Trademo uses AI to provide deep insights, ensuring visibility and compliance across global supply chains.
 



  





 Founded by Shalabh Singhal, who is a third\-time tech entrepreneur and an alumni of IIT BHU, CFA Institute USA, and Stanford GSB SEED. Our Trademo is backed by a remarkable team of leaders and entrepreneurs like Amit Singhal (Former Head of Search at Google), Sridhar Ramaswamy (CEO, Snowflake), Neeraj Arora (MD, General Catalyst \& Former CBO, Whatsapp Group).
 



  





  





**Role:** 

 Growth Marketing Associate
 




**Website:** 

 www.trademo.com
 




**Location:** 

 Gurgaon, On\-Site
 




  





**Key Responsibilities**




  




* Own end\-to\-end ABM execution: define target account lists in coordination with sales, build account\-specific campaigns, track engagement signals, and influence pipeline at the account level.
* Build and manage Trademo's lifecycle email program, including onboarding sequences, nurture flows tied to firmographic signals, and re\-engagement campaigns
* Own Trademo's events calendar end to end: webinars, trade shows, and industry roundtables, from logistics and speaker coordination to post\-event follow\-up sequences that convert attendance into pipeline.
* Run structured growth experiments across channels and programs; document learnings, kill what does not move the needle, and scale what does.
* Own the marketing tech stack including email platform, CRM integration, and ABM tooling; maintain clean data hygiene and lead scoring logic.
* Build and manage weekly and monthly reporting dashboards tracking MQLs, pipeline influenced, email performance, account engagement, and event ROI.
* Own the lead handoff process between marketing and sales, ensuring clear qualification criteria and consistent follow\-through.



  





**What We’re Looking For**




  




* 2 to 4 years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, preferably in SaaS, data, or intelligence products
* Hands\-on with email marketing platforms such as HubSpot or Marketo, and comfortable working within a CRM
* Familiar with ABM principles and at least one approach to account\-level targeting, whether tool\-driven or LinkedIn\-native
* Strong with data: can build a reporting dashboard, interpret funnel metrics, and make channel decisions based on numbers
* Good writer who can draft email copy, event landing pages, and account\-specific messaging independently
* Thrives in a fast\-moving environment and does not need perfect clarity to start executing

title: Specialist - Influencer Marketing
description:
**Role: Specialist\- Influencer Marketing** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* 3–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media marketing, or campaign management.
* Experience developing influencer strategies aligned with brand objectives and target audience demographics.
* A track record of identifying, evaluating, and reaching out to influencers across Instagram, YouTube, blogs, and other social channels.
* Hands\-on experience negotiating terms, drafting contract agreements, and managing campaign logistics (product seeding, content schedules, payments).
* Strong analytical ability to track metrics, generate performance reports, analyze campaign ROI, and present insights to key stakeholders.



  





**You should not apply if you:** 



* Dislike collaborating with influencers to give creative direction and review/approve content against brand guidelines.
* Prefer not to handle campaign logistics, scheduling, payment management, or contractual agreements.
* Are uncomfortable researching industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging social media platforms.
* Struggle with analyzing campaign performance data, key metrics, and generating reports for strategic decision\-making.



  





**Skills Required:** 



* Influencer strategy development and target audience demographic research.
* Influencer identification, evaluation (audience demographics, engagement rates, content quality, brand fit), and personalized outreach.
* Negotiation, contract agreement drafting, and payment/deliverable management.
* Campaign logistics coordination, product seeding, and publishing schedule management.
* Creative direction, content collaboration, feedback, and content review/approval.
* Performance analytics, key metric tracking (reach, engagement, conversion rates), and ROI analysis.
* Relationship management with influencers, agencies, and external partners.
* Industry trend, competitor activity, and emerging platform research.
* Performance reporting and presenting insights to key stakeholders.



  





**What will you do?** 



* **Strategy Development:** 
 Develop comprehensive influencer marketing strategies aligned with brand objectives and research industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging platforms.
* **Influencer Identification \& Outreach:** 
 Find and evaluate influencers across Instagram, YouTube, blogs, and other channels based on engagement, content quality, and brand fit, then handle outreach and negotiations.
* **Campaign Management:** 
 Conceptualize campaign ideas, coordinate product seeding, oversee content schedules, and monitor campaign performance to maximize ROI.
* **Content Collaboration:** 
 Provide creative direction and feedback, working closely with influencers to review and approve content that aligns with brand guidelines.
* **Performance Reporting:** 
 Track KPIs (reach, engagement, conversion rates), generate regular campaign performance reports, and present data\-backed recommendations to key stakeholders.
* **Relationship Management:** 
 Maintain strong long\-term relationships with influencers and agencies, acting as the primary contact while managing contracts, payments, and deliverables.



  





**What success looks like** 



* **Strategic Brand Alignment:** 
 Executing influencer strategies and content collaborations that strictly align with brand objectives, guidelines, and target demographics.
* **Campaign Optimization \& High ROI:** 
 Continuously analyzing campaign performance data and KPIs to optimize future campaigns and maximize return on investment.
* **Seamless Campaign Operations:** 
 Smooth coordination of end\-to\-end campaign logistics, from product seeding to content publishing and on\-time deliverable tracking.
* **Strong Partner Relationships:** 
 Cultivating and maintaining positive, professional relationships with influencers and external agency partners.



  





**Work Experience:** 



* 3–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, social content collaboration, or agency/brand campaign management.



  





**Working Days \& Location:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



**Location** 
 : Golf Course Road, Gurugram, Haryana
 



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life’s best work. As a part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that’s revolutionising the health industry.Working with Nutrabay can be fun, and a place of a unique growth opportunity. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will be feeling appreciated and valued for the work you delivered. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers uptill now, and our family is constantly growing. We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute towards further advancing the continuously evolving product.

In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
 



  





 Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.
 



  





 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
 



*Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.*

 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
 



  





 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
 



  





***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “
 
 name@cvent.com
 
 ” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* 









*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at
 
 recruitingindia@cvent.com
 
 .* 









*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.
 
 https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud
 
 .* 




  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 The Head of Data Strategy \& Operations is a senior leadership role responsible for building and leading the unified data function across Cvent's primary clouds: Enterprise Corporates (EC) and Hospitality (HC). This is a strategic and operational role — you will set the vision for how Cvent acquires, enriches, governs, and activates its marketing database, while managing a team of \~40 across three distinct functions.
 



  





 This is a newly created role designed to consolidate previously fragmented data functions into a single, accountable team with unified strategy, cloud\-specific ownership, and a modern AI\-native operating model. You will report into the VP, Global Demand Center and partner closely with IT, Sales, Product Marketing, and Analytics.
 



  





**What you will Be doing:** 




  





**Strategic Leadership** 



* Own the end\-to\-end data strategy for Cvent's marketing database — acquisition, enrichment, governance, and activation — across EC and HC
* Define and maintain ICP, TAM/SAM, and persona frameworks in partnership with Product Marketing and Sales
* Build and drive cloud\-specific scorecards that create clear accountability for EC and HC data quality, coverage, and campaign readiness
* Serve as the single accountable leader for the ADI function; act as the primary liaison to the VP of GDC, CMO, and cross\-functional partners



  





**Team \& Org Leadership** 



* Lead three functional sub\-teams — Audience Strategy \& Intelligence, Data Acquisition \& Activation, and Data Infrastructure \& Governance
* Develop and retain strong team leads; build career paths and capability plans within each function
* Drive a unified operating model that eliminates duplication across previously siloed teams and enables scale without proportional headcount growth



  





**Data Operations \& Quality** 



* Ensure the marketing database meets and exceeds quality thresholds: Account accuracy ≥80%, Contact accuracy ≥85%, SAM coverage \>80%
* Oversee database normalization, deduplication, governance, and data validation across both clouds
* Own vendor relationships (ZoomInfo, Clearbit, Clay and others) — qualification, contracts, budget, and performance accountability
* Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in coordination with Legal and Security



  





**AI, Automation \& IT Partnership** 



* Partner with Cvent's IT and AI Center of Excellence to build an AI\-native acquisition and enrichment operating model — agent development, workflow automation, and Snowflake pipeline integration
* Drive a unified AI roadmap for the ADI function in partnership with IT; identify and implement automation opportunities across all three sub\-functions
* Own the DB/AI Management function's IT dotted\-line relationship — translate business data needs into infrastructure requirements
* Lead adoption of AI\-assisted workflows that improve turnaround time, data accuracy, and team capacity



  





**GTM Enablement** 



* Partner with Sales and Revenue Marketing to ensure the database directly enables pipeline: right accounts, right contacts, right timing
* Ensure list pull and delivery SLAs are met for all campaign programs — including email, events, nurture, and paid digital
* Produce and maintain data scorecards and dashboards that give GDC, Sales, and Finance visibility into data health, coverage gaps, and trend



  





**What you need for this position:** 




  





**Required** 



* 20\+ years of experience in B2B marketing data, database management, or audience strategy — with at least 5 years leading multi\-functional teams of 20\+ across geographies
* Demonstrated success owning a full\-funnel data operation: strategy, acquisition, enrichment, governance, and GTM activation
* Experience managing across verticals or market segments — ability to hold EC and HC accountable simultaneously rather than specializing in one
* Strong command of SFDC — data governance, object structure, reporting, and quality management
* Experience with AI\-assisted workflows and automation tooling; comfort building and executing an AI adoption roadmap for a data team
* Proven cross\-functional partnership with IT, Sales, and Analytics — this role requires influence without authority across multiple organizations
* Track record of building and scaling teams through process improvement and technology, not just headcount



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouse; comfort partnering with engineering/IT on pipeline architecture
* Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (Marketo or equivalent) and how database feeds program execution
* Background in TAM/SAM/ICP modeling and persona framework development
* Experience with vendor management and procurement for data enrichment tools (ZoomInfo, Clearbit, or equivalents)
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Company: Worktable
 



 Website: worktable.co.in
 



 Location: Noida / Ghaziabad
 



 Experience: 1–3 Years
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Salary: ₹20,000–₹30,000 per month, depending on experience and skills
 



 About Worktable
 



 Worktable is a coworking and managed workspace business focused on helping businesses find flexible office and workspace solutions.
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Digital Marketing \& SEO Executive who can take ownership of Worktable's complete online presence, generate quality leads and continuously improve our digital visibility and website conversions.
 



 This is an execution\-focused role. The person should be able to plan, execute, monitor and improve digital marketing activities independently.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Social Media Management
 



 • Manage Worktable's LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook pages.
 



 • Create and maintain a monthly social media content calendar.
 



 • Plan and publish posts, reels, carousels, stories and other relevant content.
 



 • Improve followers, reach, engagement and overall brand visibility.
 



 • Research trending topics and relevant coworking/office\-space content.
 



 • Coordinate with designers/content creators wherever required.
 



 • Maintain consistent branding across all social platforms.
 



 • Track social media performance and suggest improvements.
 



 2\. Google Business Profile (GMB)
 



 • Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for Worktable locations.
 



 • Ensure correct business name, address, phone number, website, categories and business information.
 



 • Add/update photos, services, descriptions and other relevant information.
 



 • Regularly publish Google Business Profile posts.
 



 • Improve local SEO and Google Maps visibility.
 



 • Monitor customer reviews and coordinate responses.
 



 • Identify opportunities to increase calls, website visits and direction requests.
 



 • Track GMB performance and generate reports.
 



 • Work on local keywords for coworking, managed office, private office, meeting rooms, etc.
 



 3\. SEO \& Keyword Management
 



 • Conduct keyword research for coworking, managed offices, private offices, meeting rooms and related services.
 



 • Identify high\-intent and location\-based keywords.
 



 • Conduct competitor SEO research.
 



 • Implement on\-page SEO.
 



 • Manage Meta Titles, Meta Descriptions and relevant Meta Tags.
 



 • Optimize H1, H2 and other heading structures.
 



 • Optimize URLs, internal linking and anchor text.
 



 • Optimize image ALT tags and file names.
 



 • Identify keyword gaps and ranking opportunities.
 



 • Plan and optimize website content around relevant keywords.
 



 • Monitor keyword rankings and organic traffic.
 



 4\. Website SEO \& Optimization
 



 • Manage basic SEO activities directly on the Worktable website.
 



 • Update page titles, descriptions, headings, keywords and content.
 



 • Optimize landing pages for search engines and lead generation.
 



 • Identify broken links, indexing issues, duplicate content and other basic SEO issues.
 



 • Coordinate with the website developer for technical SEO changes.
 



 • Ensure new website pages are properly optimized before publishing.
 



 • Suggest new landing pages based on search demand.
 



 • Improve website structure, navigation and internal linking.
 



 • Ensure important pages are properly indexed by Google.
 



 • Basic knowledge of WordPress/CMS will be preferred.
 



 5\. Lead Generation
 



 The candidate will be responsible for generating qualified business leads, not just website traffic.
 



 • Plan and execute lead\-generation campaigns.
 



 • Generate leads through Google, Meta, LinkedIn, GMB, SEO and other relevant channels.
 



 • Understand the difference between traffic, enquiries and qualified leads.
 



 • Create and optimize lead\-generation landing pages.
 



 • Set up and optimize lead forms.
 



 • Track lead source and campaign performance.
 



 • Monitor CPL (Cost Per Lead), number of leads and lead quality.
 



 • Work with the sales team to understand lead quality and improve campaigns accordingly.
 



 • Maintain proper lead tracking and reporting.
 



 • Identify new digital channels and opportunities for lead generation.
 



 6\. Website Forms \& Lead Capture
 



 The candidate should understand how website enquiries are captured and routed.
 



 • Create/maintain enquiry forms on the website.
 



 • Forms may include:
 



 o Name
 



 o Mobile Number
 



 o Email
 



 o Requirement – Coworking / Managed Office
 



 o Number of Seats
 



 o Preferred Location
 



 o Move\-in Requirement / Timeline
 



 o Any other relevant requirement
 



 • Ensure form submissions are successfully received by the relevant team.
 



 • Test forms regularly to ensure there are no missed enquiries.
 



 • Set up proper thank\-you/confirmation messages where required.
 



 • Track form submissions and conversion rates.
 



 • Coordinate with the developer for form, API, tracking or technical requirements.
 



 7\. Website Conversion \& CRO
 



 The candidate should also understand how to convert website visitors into enquiries.
 



 • Add/optimize WhatsApp, Call and Email CTA buttons.
 



 • Suggest suitable enquiry buttons at relevant places on the website.
 



 • Create/optimize enquiry pop\-ups.
 



 • Suggest lead\-capture forms based on visitor intent.
 



 • Improve landing\-page conversion.
 



 • Test different CTA text, forms and placement.
 



 • Track website enquiries and conversion rates.
 



 • Identify pages receiving traffic but generating fewer leads and recommend improvements.
 



 8\. Meta Marketing \& Advertising
 



 • Manage Meta Business Suite.
 



 • Plan and publish content on Facebook and Instagram.
 



 • Create and monitor Meta Ads campaigns.
 



 • Run lead\-generation campaigns where required.
 



 • Set up audiences and basic retargeting campaigns.
 



 • Monitor budget, CPL, leads and campaign performance.
 



 • Optimize campaigns based on results.
 



 • Coordinate creatives and ad copies with the team.
 



 9\. Google Ads
 



 Basic hands\-on knowledge of Google Ads will be preferred.
 



 • Search campaign setup and management.
 



 • Keyword research.
 



 • Negative keyword management.
 



 • Ad copy optimization.
 



 • Location and audience targeting.
 



 • Lead conversion tracking.
 



 • Monitoring CPC, CPL and conversion rate.
 



 • Basic campaign optimization.
 



 10\. Google Search Console \& Analytics
 



 • Manage Google Search Console.
 



 • Monitor indexing and search performance.
 



 • Track clicks, impressions, CTR and average position.
 



 • Identify search queries and ranking opportunities.
 



 • Monitor website traffic through Google Analytics.
 



 • Track important website conversions and enquiry sources.
 



 • Prepare regular performance reports.
 



 11\. Content \& Local SEO
 



 • Identify topics based on customer search behaviour.
 



 • Create content briefs for blogs and landing pages.
 



 • Optimize existing website content.
 



 • Work on location\-based pages for different Worktable centres/markets.
 



 • Build local SEO visibility.
 



 • Suggest content that can generate organic enquiries.
 



 12\. Tracking \& Analytics
 



 Candidate should understand basic digital marketing tracking, including:
 



 • Google Analytics
 



 • Google Search Console
 



 • Meta Pixel
 



 • Conversion tracking
 



 • UTM parameters
 



 • Lead\-source tracking
 



 • Website form tracking
 



 • Call/WhatsApp enquiry tracking
 



 • Campaign performance tracking
 



 13\. Reporting \& MIS
 



 Prepare weekly/monthly reports covering:
 



 • Website traffic
 



 • Organic traffic
 



 • Keyword rankings
 



 • GMB performance
 



 • Social media growth
 



 • Social media engagement
 



 • Leads generated
 



 • Qualified leads
 



 • Cost per lead
 



 • Meta Ads performance
 



 • Google Ads performance
 



 • Website enquiries
 



 • Conversion rate
 



 The person should not only provide numbers but also highlight what is working, what is not working and what should be done next.
 



 Required Skills
 



 • Digital Marketing
 



 • SEO
 



 • Keyword Research
 



 • On\-Page SEO
 



 • Local SEO
 



 • Google Business Profile (GMB)
 



 • Social Media Marketing
 



 • Meta Business Suite
 



 • Meta Ads
 



 • Google Ads – basic to intermediate
 



 • Google Analytics
 



 • Google Search Console
 



 • Website SEO
 



 • WordPress/CMS – preferred
 



 • Lead Generation
 



 • Landing Page Optimization
 



 • Conversion Rate Optimization
 



 • Basic HTML/website understanding – preferred
 



 • Basic understanding of tracking pixels, forms and conversion tracking
 



 • Good content\-writing and communication skills
 



 Preferred Experience
 



 Experience in any of the following industries will be an advantage:
 



 • Coworking
 



 • Managed Offices
 



 • Commercial Real Estate
 



 • Real Estate
 



 • B2B
 



 • SaaS
 



 • Lead Generation
 



 • Local Businesses
 



 What We Are Looking For
 



 We are not looking for someone who only manages social media posts.
 



 We need a hands\-on all\-round digital marketer who can take ownership of:
 



 Social Media \+ SEO \+ GMB \+ Website SEO \+ Keywords \+ Meta Tags \+ Lead Generation \+ Meta Ads \+ Google Ads \+ Website Forms \+ Conversion Optimization \+ Analytics \+ Reporting.
 



 The candidate should be comfortable doing the work themselves, while coordinating with the website developer wherever coding or technical changes are required.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance will primarily be evaluated on:
 



 • Growth in organic website traffic
 



 • Improvement in keyword rankings
 



 • Google Maps/GMB visibility
 



 • Website enquiries
 



 • Qualified leads generated
 



 • Cost per lead
 



 • Social media growth and engagement
 



 • Website conversion rate
 



 • Digital brand visibility
 



 • Overall lead\-generation performance
 



 Salary: ₹20,000–₹30,000/month, depending on practical knowledge and experience.
 



 To Apply: Please share your CV along with examples/links of websites, social media pages, SEO projects, GMB profiles or digital marketing campaigns you have handled.

**as you are with:**

*why*

 Full\-time

**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Offline Marketing \& Event Strategy
 


* Develop and execute the annual and monthly
 **offline marketing and activation calendar** 
 .
* Identify high\-impact opportunities across exhibitions, trade fairs, RWAs, retail, communities, wellness events, corporate events and other relevant channels.
* Develop activation concepts that drive
 **brand visibility, product discovery and customer acquisition** 
 .
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience quality, expected reach, cost and potential business impact.
* Manage event budgets, timelines, resources and execution plans.



 2\. End\-to\-End Event Execution
 


* Own events and activations from
 **planning → vendor coordination → setup → execution → closure → reporting** 
 .
* Manage stall design, branding, inventory, sampling material, manpower, logistics and on\-ground requirements.
* Coordinate with agencies, vendors, venues, event organisers and internal teams.
* Conduct site visits and ensure readiness ahead of every activation.
* Be present on\-ground to manage execution and troubleshoot issues in real time.
* Ensure brand guidelines and customer experience standards are maintained across every activation.



 3\. Customer Acquisition \& Brand Engagement
 


* Design experiences that encourage
 **customer interaction, product trials and conversion** 
 .
* Build effective sampling, demonstration and product education strategies.
* Create mechanisms to capture leads and customer data during offline activations.
* Work towards converting event footfall into measurable leads, trials, sales and repeat customers.
* Experiment with new activation formats to improve engagement and conversion.
* Ensure every offline touchpoint strengthens brand awareness and recall.



 4\. Partnerships \& New Channels
 


* Identify and build partnerships with
 **RWAs, communities, fitness centres, wellness platforms, corporates, retail partners, events and lifestyle brands** 
 .
* Explore new offline channels and formats to expand customer reach.
* Identify recurring activation opportunities that can become scalable acquisition channels.
* Support product launches, seasonal campaigns and major brand initiatives through offline activations.



 5\. Team \& Vendor Management
 


* Lead and manage event executives, promoters, brand representatives and temporary manpower.
* Train teams on product knowledge, customer interaction and execution standards.
* Build and manage relationships with event agencies, vendors, organisers and venue partners.
* Negotiate commercials, deliverables and timelines with external partners.
* Ensure vendors deliver against agreed quality, timelines and budgets.



 6\. Performance \& ROI
 


* Define clear KPIs for every activation based on its objective.
* Track metrics such as:
* Footfall
* Samples distributed
* Product trials
* Leads generated
* Customer acquisition
* Sales generated
* Conversion rate
* Cost per lead / acquisition
* ROI
* Maintain event\-wise budgets and performance reports.
* Analyse what worked and what didn't across activations.
* Use data and customer feedback to continuously improve future campaigns.
* Build a structured database of event performance to identify the most effective offline channels.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **3–6 years of experience** 
 in Event Marketing, BTL Marketing, Experiential Marketing, Field Marketing or Brand Activations.
* Hands\-on experience managing
 **consumer\-facing events and activations** 
 .
* Experience across exhibitions, retail activations, sampling campaigns, corporate events, community activations or similar formats.
* Strong project management and vendor management skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple activations simultaneously.
* Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable managing budgets, logistics, manpower and on\-ground execution.
* Strong commercial mindset with an understanding of
 **customer acquisition and ROI** 
 .
* Comfortable working on weekends and travelling when required.
* High energy, ownership and ability to solve problems quickly on the ground.



  





**You'll Be a Strong Fit If You** 



* Enjoy being
 **on the ground rather than sitting behind a desk** 
 .
* Can turn a marketing brief into a well\-executed physical experience.
* Have strong vendor and event\-industry relationships.
* Understand that an event is not successful just because it looked good — it needs to
 **drive measurable business outcomes** 
 .
* Are comfortable managing last\-minute changes and operational challenges.
* Naturally think about
 **footfall → engagement → trial → conversion → revenue** 
 .
* Have a strong bias towards execution and getting things done.



  





**Why Join?** 



* Own the company's
 **offline growth and activation charter** 
 .

title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
description:
**Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion\+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path from here is fluid:** 
 all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P\&L ownership. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress\-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi\-million\-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



  





 This role exists to convert a multi\-million\-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day\-to\-day executive involvement.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:** 
 A multi\-million\-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non\-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



  




* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:** 
 Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day\-to\-day executive oversight.



  





**The Career Accelerator:** 




 This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce** 
 : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.



  





**What Is In It For You:** 




 This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You** 




 You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
 



  




* You allocate multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
* You hold profitability to a contribution\-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign\-off, reporting directly to the CEO.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 



* 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
* 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
* 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire** 




 In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need:** 



* 7\+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M\+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
* Google depth at PMax\-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non\-brand economics.
* High\-AOV considered\-purchase experience ($1,000\+ order values): sparse\-conversion, long\-decision\-cycle categories.
* Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
* Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false\-kill vs. wasted\-spend trade\-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
* Creative testing systems at scale in a post\-ATT environment: concept\-vs\-variation discipline, creative analytics.
* Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
* Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.



  





**Good\-to\-Have:** 



* Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
* Mixed agency \+ in\-house background.
* Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
* D2C e\-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high\-AOV verticals.



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* 💰
 **Compensation:** 
 Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)



 Annual salary review every January
 


* 🏥
 **Health \& Protection:** 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
* 🌴
 **Time Off:** 
 Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Public holidays



  





 💼
 **Work Environment:** 



* AI\-First organization with access to AI\-native tool stack
* Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
* Learning \& development opportunities
* International team collaboration across 16\+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.



  





**🏆 Rewards \& Recognition:** 



* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company\-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

 Click "Apply" and take the first step.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Velric is a two\-sided business and you own both sides of it.
 



  





 On one side, US companies who need operational headcount they cannot afford to hire domestically. On the other, Indian professionals who need to want to work for Velric before they will ever apply. We need roughly 100,000\+ evaluated candidates in our talent pools by March, and candidates do not appear because someone posted a job.
 



  





**What you own** 



* What Velric is, how it looks and how it sounds, on both sides of the market. It does not exist yet in any consistent form. You define it.
* Website. Currently unowned. It is the destination for every click, every search, and every candidate deciding whether we are real.
* Employer\-side demand. Content, search, and the founder's existing audience of 10,000 subscribers, turned into inbound that does not depend on SDR headcount.
* Candidate\-side attraction. Making Velric a company Indian talent wants to join. This is half the business and it is usually nobody's job. Here it is yours.
* Announcements and momentum. Every client signed, every partnership, every milestone. Investors and partners watch this page, and the story of a company compounding is told in public or not at all.
* Newsletter. Owned, written, shipped on a schedule.
* Events. Selected on buyer density rather than brand name, run end to end, measured on meetings produced.
* Sales collateral. The one\-pager, proposals, case studies from real placements, the proof pack for larger mandates.
* Founder content. Daily output on LinkedIn and short\-form video, produced with the founder rather than by him. He will be running a floor in Gurgaon and cannot be the content engine.



  





**You** 



* You have owned a B2B marketing function end to end, not a channel inside one
* You have built a brand from close to nothing rather than maintaining an established one
* You can produce, not just direct. Copy, pages and visual assets ship from you
* You have marketed to two distinct audiences at once, or can convincingly explain how you would
* You are measured on meetings sourced and candidates attracted, not impressions



  





**Not a fit** 




 Anyone whose reporting centres on reach, followers or engagement. Agency backgrounds without in\-house ownership. Channel specialists. This role is wide on purpose.

title: CRO Lead
description:
**OneMetric \| Full\-time \| Gurgaon**
****The role in one line****
 This is not a "manage the website" role or a CRO role for its own sake — it's a lead\-generation role that uses the website as the primary lever. You own the website end to end — from a raw idea for a page to a shipped, converting landing page — against one defined outcome: 35–50 MQLs a month generated organically from the website and the motions around it.
   

  

****Why this role exists****
 Most people who "manage the website" either write copy and hand it to a designer, or build pages and wait for someone else to tell them what to put on them. We need someone who does both halves in one head: knows what a page needs to say because they've done the research and talked to customers, and knows why a page converts or doesn't because they think like a CRO person, not just a writer or a builder. The output is a live, working page — not a doc that someone else has to translate.
   

  

******What You'll Own******
* The website as a whole — structure, page inventory, and how it evolves as the company's positioning evolves.
* Idea → live page. You take a rough brief ("we need a page for X service" or "we're repositioning around Y") and turn it into a wireframe, then real copy, then a shipped page — working with a designer where needed, but driving the thing yourself.
* Conversion performance — what's converting, what isn't, and why. You run the experiments, not just report the numbers.
* Lead capture and funnel logic on\-site — forms, CTAs, gating, the path from a visitor landing on a page to becoming a lead in HubSpot.
* The lead number. 35–50 organic leads/month from the website and the motions around it (SEO, AEO, on\-site conversion, content) is your number. The page isn't done when it ships — it's done when it's producing.


****What you'll actually do, week to week****
* Talk to customers and internal stakeholders (sales, delivery, leadership) to figure out what a page actually needs to say to move a buyer — not guess at it from a template.
* Look at signals — search intent, competitor positioning, what prospects ask sales, what's converting elsewhere — and turn them into a point of view on what the page should be.
* Write the copy yourself. This isn't a hand\-off role — strong, clear, buyer\-facing writing is a core skill here, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Sketch wireframes and work directly with a designer (or design tools yourself) to get from idea to a real, live example fast.
* Build and manage pages in WordPress and HubSpot CMS.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma as part of your everyday workflow — for research, drafting, quick mockups, and design iteration.
* Structure pages and content for both traditional SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization) — so the site shows up in Google and gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.
* Track what's converting and what's not, and keep iterating rather than treating a page as "done" once it ships.


****What we need****
* A CRO brain. You should be able to look at a page and say, with reasons, why it will or won't convert — and know how to fix it. This means understanding funnels, lead capture mechanics, and what actually moves a B2B buyer to act.
* Strong writing, in service of strategy. You can write clean, persuasive copy, but more importantly you know what needs to be said and why, before you write a word.
* A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design. You don't need to be the designer, but you need the taste to know what good B2B design looks like and the ability to brief and push back on one.
* The ability to simplify. You can take a genuinely complex service or technical concept (a RevOps build, an AI GTM agent) and explain it in language a buyer actually understands.
* A working understanding of AEO and SEO. You know how to structure and write content so it ranks in search and gets picked up and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — this isn't optional anymore for a website role.
* Strong writing skills paired with AI fluency. You write well yourself, and you use AI tools to move fast — generating quick mockups, drafts, and iterations rather than waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.
* Comfort with the tools: WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Figma, and AI tools (Claude and similar) as part of daily work.
* Ownership instinct — you treat the website as yours, not as a queue of tickets from other teams.
* 4–5 years of experience working on websites/landing pages, ideally with direct exposure to conversion work, not just content or design in isolation.


****What's in it for you****
* Ownership, not a task list. We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes. Direction and context get discussed openly, and then the "how" — the wireframe, the copy, the page — is yours to run with.
* A performance\-driven culture. Speed and conversion results define your trajectory here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the numbers, and get rewarded for it.
* Access to the top of the market. The pages you build speak to CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes work, not busywork nobody reads.


****How we'll know this is working****
 Within a quarter: organic leads from the website and its motions are trending toward the 35–50/month range, pages you've shipped are outperforming what existed before on conversion, sales and leadership are coming to you first when a new page or repositioning is needed, and the website stops feeling like a static asset and starts feeling like something that's actively working for the business.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales, delivery leads, and a designer (in\-house or external) to take ideas from brief to live page.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 This role reports to the CEO’s office at OneMetric and works closely with sales and delivery leaders on HubSpot implementation, RevOps, and GTM projects.

title: Deputy Category Manager - Plants/Flowers
description:
**Assistant Category Manager – Plants \& Flowers** 




  





 Experience:
 **2–5 years** 




  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for an
 **Assistant Category Manager – Plants \& Flowers** 
 to manage and grow the Plants \& Flowers category at FNP. The role will be responsible for driving category growth through the right assortment, pricing, merchandising, promotions, inventory planning, and customer\-focused product strategy.
 



 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of
 **e\-commerce/D2C category management** 
 , commercial metrics, consumer behaviour, and product merchandising, along with the ability to work closely with internal and external stakeholders.
 



 This is a hands\-on role that requires a combination of
 **analytical thinking, commercial acumen, execution excellence, and strong ownership** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Category Management \& Growth
 


* Own the day\-to\-day management and growth of the
 **Plants \& Flowers category** 
 on FNP's digital platforms.
* Track category performance and identify opportunities to drive revenue, orders, margins, and customer penetration.
* Develop and execute category plans aligned with business objectives and seasonal demand.
* Identify gaps in the category and recommend new products, sub\-categories, price points, and assortment opportunities.
* Monitor category trends, consumer preferences, competitor offerings, and emerging opportunities.



 2\. Assortment \& Product Management
 


* Build and manage an optimal assortment of
 **indoor plants, outdoor plants, flowering plants, planters, bouquets, flower arrangements, gifting combinations, and related products** 
 .
* Analyse product\-level performance and optimise the assortment based on sales, margin, conversion, availability, and customer demand.
* Identify products that need to be introduced, scaled, repositioned, or discontinued.
* Work with relevant teams to ensure accurate product information, images, descriptions, pricing, and merchandising.



 3\. Commercial \& P\&L Management
 


* Monitor key category metrics including:
* Revenue and GMV
* Orders and AOV
* Gross margin / contribution margin
* Conversion rate
* Product\-level profitability
* Discounting and promotional performance
* Inventory availability
* Support category\-level P\&L management and identify opportunities to improve profitability.
* Analyse pricing and discount structures and recommend actions to improve both growth and margins.



 4\. Merchandising \& Promotions
 


* Plan and execute category merchandising across website/app and other relevant channels.
* Identify products and collections to be promoted during key occasions and seasonal periods.
* Work with marketing, content, and creative teams to develop compelling category campaigns and product visibility.
* Analyse promotional performance and optimise campaigns based on commercial outcomes.



 5\. Inventory \& Availability
 


* Work closely with supply chain, procurement, operations, and fulfilment teams to ensure product availability.
* Monitor stock levels, availability, ageing, sell\-through, and inventory health.
* Identify potential stock\-outs and excess inventory and take corrective actions.
* Factor in seasonality, occasions, regional demand, and product shelf life while planning category requirements.



 6\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Coordinate with vendors, nurseries, florists, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure availability, quality, pricing, and timely execution.
* Support vendor negotiations and commercial discussions where required.
* Work closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, Marketing, Technology, Content, and Finance teams.
* Ensure category initiatives are executed within agreed timelines.



 7\. Data \& Competitive Analysis
 


* Regularly analyse category dashboards and identify trends, gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Conduct competitor benchmarking across assortment, pricing, promotions, product presentation, and customer proposition.
* Develop actionable insights from category data and present recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Track category KPIs and prepare periodic performance reviews.



 8\. Customer \& Market Understanding
 


* Understand customer needs and buying behaviour within the plants and flowers category.
* Analyse customer feedback, reviews, search behaviour, and product\-level performance to identify opportunities.
* Identify emerging trends in
 **home décor, indoor gardening, gifting, flowers, plants, and lifestyle products** 
 and translate them into commercial opportunities.



 Key Performance Indicators
 



 The role will be measured on:
 


* Category Revenue / GMV growth
* Order growth
* Gross / Contribution Margin
* AOV
* Conversion Rate
* Assortment productivity
* Product availability
* Sell\-through
* Inventory health
* New product contribution
* Promotional ROI
* Category customer growth and repeat purchase



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 



* **2–5 years of experience** 
 in Category Management, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Buying, Business Management, or a similar role.

 **e\-commerce, D2C, retail, consumer internet, lifestyle, gifting, home décor, or related categories**

title: Lead - Performance Marketing
description:
**About the role** 




 You will own top of funnel for Ambak's direct business: every rupee of paid media across Meta, Google, and social, and the influencer engine we are building alongside it. This is not e\-commerce performance marketing. A home\-loan lead takes days to qualify and weeks to disburse, the ticket is the largest loan of a customer's life, and nobody impulse\-buys a mortgage off a Reel. Cheap leads are everywhere here \- qualified intent is the scarce thing. You will be judged on leads that become logins and logins that become disbursals, not on a CPL screenshot. You report to the D2C Business Head and work daily with creative, tech, and the calling floor.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **Own the media plan.** 
 Budgets, allocation, and pacing across Meta and Google. Meta is already delivering leads at a fraction of Google's cost per lead \- where the next rupee goes is a live, open question, and it will be yours to answer with data.
* **Own lead quality, not just CPL.** 
 Today roughly 7 out of 100 leads qualify. A Rs 90 lead that never qualifies costs more than a Rs 400 lead that does. You optimize to qualified leads and logins, and you say so in every review.
* **Build the creative engine.** 
 A weekly pipeline of testable themes \- rate\-audit hooks, switch\-myth busters, vernacular variants \- with a real experiment framework: hypotheses, kill criteria, and the discipline to scale what wins and bury what doesn't.
* **Build influencer marketing from zero.** 
 Pick the creators, write the briefs, structure whitelisting and partnership ads, and track it to leads \- not views. In a category built on distrust, a trusted face explaining "check what rate you're actually paying" outperforms a banner. You'll prove it.
* **Plan two months ahead.** 
 Lead\-to\-disbursal runs longer than a month, so September's spends are November's disbursals. You plan ToF and creative capacity on that clock, not this week's dashboard.
* **Instrument the funnel.** 
 One view from ad impression to disbursal \- by channel, theme, and campaign \- so we know which rupee produced which loan.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* \[4\-7] years running performance marketing with real budget ownership, and a number you personally moved. Fintech or lending helps; any high\-consideration, long\-cycle category helps more than pure D2C.
* You have run, or deeply studied, creator\-led and whitelisted ads \- and you can argue both sides of when they beat brand\-handle ads.
* You have creative judgment. You can look at a hook and say why it will or won't stop the scroll, and you can brief a designer without a brand book.
* You run your own analysis. Sheets, SQL, platform exports \- we don't care which. You never wait on an analyst to tell you what your campaign did.
* You write clearly, you default to action, and "that's the agency's job" is not a sentence you say.



  





**Why Ambak** 



* A real problem at real scale: \~Rs 1,300 Cr in monthly disbursals, 50\+ lending partners, and a category \- home finance \- that India agrees is broken and nobody has fixed.
* A real seat: the channel, the budget, and the creative strategy are yours to set. Zero\-to\-one, with the founders in the room.
* Coaching is how we manage. Difficult questions will be direct.
* We are far more worried about people not daring than about them failing.
* Backed by Peak XV and Z47, building the mortgage infrastructure India actually deserves.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Digital Marketing Manager who can help us move even faster.
 



  





**noon’s mission: Every door, every day.** 




  





**About Dubai Mall** 




 The Dubai Mall Online is the official digital platform of Dubai Mall, bringing together the mall’s iconic retail brands into a single online shopping destination. Powered by best\-in\-class e\-commerce technology, logistics, and customer experience capabilities, the platform enables customers to discover, shop, and receive products from multiple Dubai Mall retailers through a seamless digital journey.
 



  





 Joining The Dubai Mall Online offers a unique opportunity to help build and scale a high\-growth business from the ground up, working alongside some of the world’s most recognized brands while shaping the future of omnichannel retail in the GCC.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 As the Digital Marketing Manager, you will take full ownership of the paid user acquisition strategy, multi\-channel performance media, and app growth for Dubai Mall Online. This role bridges analytical rigor with high\-scale campaign execution to drive installs and first\-order conversion. You will work closely with external media agencies, Analytics, Commercial, and the Emaar ecosystem team to operationalize our paid media stack across Meta, Google, TikTok, and App Stores, ensuring a growing customer base while maintaining optimal Customer Acquisition Costs (CAC).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 •
 **Own Paid Acquisition Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end performance marketing across core digital channels including Meta (Advantage\+/DPA), Google Ads (PMax/App Campaigns), TikTok, Apple Search Ads (ASA), and Google Search.
 



 •
 **Media Agency Governance:** 
 Manage day\-to\-day campaign operations, directing account structures, budget allocation, bidding strategies, and holding the agency accountable to tight CPI and CAC scorecards.
 



 •
 **App Store Optimization (ASO):** 
 Direct the optimization of iOS App Store and Google Play Store listings in both English and Arabic, managing screenshots, preview videos, keyword defense strategies, and ATT prompt sequencing.
 



 •
 **MMP \& Tracking Operations:** 
 Partner with Tech and Analytics to ensure flawless execution of Adjust tracking, SKAN 4\.0 schema configuration, deferred deep\-linking infrastructure, and attribution logic across the entire paid media stack.
 



 •
 **Creative Variant Strategy:** 
 Supply the creative vision and testing roadmap for paid campaigns, ensuring the continuous delivery of high\-performing, localized (EN \& AR) video and static ad formats.
 



 •
 **Dynamic Catalog \& Feed\-Based Marketing:** 
 Own the commercial execution of feed\-driven ad formats (Meta Dynamic Product Ads, Google Merchant Center feeds, TikTok Catalog Sales campaigns). Manage product feed architecture, custom label segmentation (e.g., luxury vs. lifestyle, margin bands, high\-stock SKUs, top sellers), and automated dynamic retargeting funnels across hundreds of tenant doors.
 



 •
 **Feed Health \& Catalog Troubleshooting:** 
 Partner closely with Senior Digital Merchandisers and Platform Tech to monitor catalog feed health, resolve item disapprovals, fix missing attribute/GTIN errors, and enforce real\-time price and inventory sync frequencies to protect ad spend efficiency.
 



 •
 **Channel\-Level Problem Solving:** 
 Act as the primary point of escalation for platform approvals, navigating Google Merchant Center feed integrations, Meta domain verifications, and App Store review blockages.
 



 •
 **Promotional Campaign Phasing:** 
 Align performance media spend with the onsite merchandising calendar, synchronizing ad budgets with critical shopping events, payday windows, and major brand launches.
 



 •
 **Budget Management \& Pacing:** 
 Control the performance media budget, utilizing daily spend APIs and war\-room dashboards to dynamically shift budgets across channels to maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).
 



  





**What You'll Need** 




 • 5\+ years of experience leading digital acquisition and performance marketing for consumer mobile apps, multi\-brand e\-commerce platforms, or retail marketplaces.
 



 • Demonstrated expertise in dynamic feed\-based marketing, Google Merchant Center management, Meta Dynamic Product Ads (DPA), and custom label catalog taxonomy.
 



 • Hands\-on experience managing campaign budgets natively within Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, and Apple Search Ads Advanced.
 



 • Proven track record of managing global performance marketing agencies and holding external partners accountable to stringent ROI metrics.
 



 • Exceptional data fluency and analytical capability, with a relentless focus on customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, and incremental lift.
 



 • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable navigating technical ad\-ops and catalog feed challenges from scratch in a high\-velocity, pre\-launch environment.
 



 • Professional fluency in English; Arabic language proficiency is a strong advantage.
 



  





**Who will excel?** 




 • We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
 



 • You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
 



 • We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
 



 • noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

 **Post** 
**Creative Strategist**

With a workforce of 60\+ employees, you can be assured of a great learning curve, where in addition to your role, you often contribute inputs to teams you work alongside. 
 



  





 Regardless of your location or position, every member of the Scatter team is united by a common goal: create content that creates BUSINESS IMPACT for our clients. 
 



  





 About the job 
 



 Position: Manager \- Social Media Strategy 
 



 Years of Experience: 5\+ years  
 



 CTC: Up to 15 LPA 
 



  





 Annual Retention Bonus – 10%. This is part of the above CTC and released on completion of one year. Subject to being on the payroll and not serving a notice period. 
 



  





  
 



 City: Delhi 
 



  





  
 



 Key Responsibilities 
 



  





 New Account Onboarding 
 



  





 Own the onboarding of our upcoming marquee accounts, translating the client's brand and business objectives into a clear social\-first strategy from day one. 
 



  





 Lead the platform strategy, content pillars, and posting cadence for the account across relevant social platforms. 
 



  





 Existing Accounts 
 



  





 Take ownership of the social media strategy for the existing accounts, ensuring content is aligned with the brand's tone, compliance needs, and business goals. 
 



  





 Drive the quarterly and monthly content calendars, campaign concepts, and platform\-specific strategies for the account. 
 



  





 Track and report on content performance, using data to sharpen strategy and improve engagement, reach, and conversion metrics. 
 



  





 Build strong working relationships with client stakeholders and represent Scatter confidently in strategy calls and reviews. 
 



  





 Strategy \& Team Collaboration 
 



  





 Stay ahead of platform algorithm changes, format trends, and emerging social behaviours, and translate these into actionable recommendations for clients. 
 



  





 Collaborate closely with content, design, and video teams to ensure strategy translates into high\-quality creative output. 
 



  





 Mentor junior executives on the team, reviewing their content plans and coaching them on strategic thinking. 
 



  





 Contribute to new business pitches with social media strategy inputs when required. 
 



  





 Qualifications 
 



  





 5\+ years of experience working exclusively in social media strategy, community management, or social\-first content roles (agency experience mandatory). 
 



  





 Proven track record of growing and managing social media accounts end\-to\-end, from strategy to execution to reporting. 
 



  





 Structured, data\-informed, and comfortable owning a strategy independently. 
 



  





 Can lead by example and connect with clients across the ranks. 
 



  





 Articulate and enjoy presenting strategy and performance to clients. 
 



  





 Can multitask and manage multiple accounts and deadlines at the same time. 
 



  





 Stay updated with the latest social media platform trends, formats, and content consumption behaviour. 
 



  





  
 



  





 And finally, what's it like working with us? 
 



  





 We're all about celebrating differences, working together like a well\-oiled machine, and making sure every team member feels empowered to bring their A\-game. Along with an exciting salary package and medical insurance, you'll also enjoy an annual week off for the whole crew from Christmas to the New year (yeah, it's on the house, not cutting into your regular leave stash). 
 



  





 It's not just a job; it's a place where your ideas matter, your uniqueness is celebrated, and your career growth is a big deal. We can't wait to have you on board and be part of the Scatter story!

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a \*hands\-on Head of Marketing / Growth Lead\* to own marketing end\-to\-end
 



  





 This is not a role for someone who only manages agencies, reviews dashboards, or creates strategy decks. We want an \*operator\* who can define the GTM strategy and then get into the tools and execute it.
 



  





 You’ll own the full growth engine — \*performance marketing, analytics, website \& CRO, SEO, content, and GTM.\*
 



  





 \#\# What You'll Own
 



  





 \#\#\# GTM \& Growth
 



  





 \* Own the marketing and go\-to\-market strategy end\-to\-end.
 



 \* Understand our ICP, customer journeys, use cases and buying triggers.
 



 \* Translate company goals into acquisition, activation and revenue targets.
 



 \* Identify new channels and growth opportunities and rapidly test them.
 



 \* Own the marketing funnel from first touch through conversion.
 



  





 \#\#\# Performance Marketing
 



  





 \* Personally manage and optimize paid acquisition across \*Google, Meta, LinkedIn and other relevant channels\*.
 



 \* Build campaigns, audiences, creatives, landing pages and experiments.
 



 \* Own CAC, CPL, conversion rates, ROAS and pipeline contribution.
 



 \* Continuously test messaging, targeting, channels and offers.
 



 \* Scale what works and kill what doesn't.
 



  





 \#\#\# Analytics \& Attribution
 



  





 \* Own marketing measurement across \*GA4, GTM and our analytics stack\*.
 



 \* Ensure conversion tracking and attribution are set up correctly.
 



 \* Build dashboards for acquisition, funnel performance and revenue.
 



 \* Diagnose funnel drop\-offs and identify opportunities using data.
 



 \* Make marketing decisions based on numbers rather than intuition alone.
 



  





 \#\#\# Website \& CRO
 



  





 \* Own the website as a growth channel.
 



 \* Improve positioning, messaging, landing pages and conversion journeys.
 



 \* Work directly in our CMS and with design/development where needed.
 



 \* Run structured CRO and A/B testing.
 



 \* Create landing pages for campaigns, segments and use cases.
 



  





 \#\#\# SEO \& Content
 



  





 \* Build and execute our organic growth strategy.
 



 \* Own technical, on\-page and content\-led SEO.
 



 \* Identify high\-intent keywords and content opportunities.
 



 \* Build briefs and work with writers/designers where required.
 



 \* Create a content engine that contributes to traffic, sign\-ups and revenue — not content for content's sake.
 



  





 \#\# Who We're Looking For
 



  





 You probably have \*2\-4 years of experience\* across growth, performance or digital marketing.
 



  





 More importantly, you have actually \*done the work yourself\*.
 



  





 You should be comfortable opening Google Ads in the morning, looking at GA4 and funnel data in the afternoon, rewriting a landing page, identifying an SEO opportunity and then deciding where the next ₹1 lakh of marketing budget should go.
 



  





 \#\#\# Must Have
 



  





 \* Strong hands\-on performance marketing experience.
 



 \* Strong Google Ads experience; Meta and/or LinkedIn Ads experience.
 



 \* Working knowledge of \*GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking\*.
 



 \* Experience owning or materially improving a website/landing pages.
 



 \* Understanding of \*CRO and experimentation\*.
 



 \* Strong understanding of SEO and content\-led acquisition.
 



 \* Ability to analyse funnels and turn data into actions.
 



 \* Strong copy, messaging and positioning instincts.
 



 \* Experience owning meaningful marketing budgets.
 



 \* Bias toward execution and experimentation.
 



  





 \#\#\# Strong Plus
 



  





 \* B2B SaaS experience.
 



 \* Product\-led growth / self\-serve SaaS experience.
 



 \* Experience marketing to international customers.
 



 \* Experience in collaboration software, MarTech, event\-tech, productivity or adjacent SaaS categories.
 



 \* Experience building a growth function from an early stage.
 



  





 \#\# What We're NOT Looking For
 



  





 This probably isn't the right role if your experience is primarily:
 



  





 \* Managing agencies without personally running campaigns.
 



 \* Brand/social media marketing without measurable acquisition ownership.
 



 \* Managing a large marketing team while being removed from execution.
 



 \* Performance marketing limited to reporting rather than campaign ownership.
 



 \* SEO or content alone without broader growth experience.
 



  





 \#\# What Success Looks Like
 



  





 Within your first few months, you should be able to clearly answer:
 



  





 \*Where are our best customers coming from?\*
 



  





 \*What does it cost to acquire them?\*
 



  





 \*Where are we losing users in the funnel?\*
 



  





 \*Which messages, audiences and channels convert best?\*
 



  





 \*What should we invest the next ₹10 lakh of marketing budget into — and why?\*
 



  





 And then execute against those answers.
 



  





 \#\# Location \& Compensation
 



  





 \*Location:\* Gurgaon / Gurugram(Hybrid)
 



 \*Compensation:\* ₹10\-15 LPA, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.
 



  





 We're open to someone already leading marketing, or a \*high\-performing Growth / Performance Marketing Manager ready to step up and own the entire function.\*
 



  




* The title matters less to us than your ability to \*own the number and execute.
